author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 여름철새 수천 마리
summary: 낮은 산지와 넓게 트인 개활지, 농경지, 주택가 둘레에 살며 전국에서 볼 수 있다. 한 해에 알을 10~20개 낳아 다른 종의 둥지에 하나씩 맡기는데, 먼저 둥지 주인의 알 하나를 치우고 제 알을 넣는다. 우리나라에 오는 뻐꾸기의 알은 파란색이어서, 붉은머리오목눈이 둥지 가운데 흰 알이 든 둥지보다 파란 알이 든 둥지를 주로 고른다. 국외에서는 유라시아의 온대~아한대, 아프리카 중부~남부, 동남아시아, 수마트라, 보르네오, 일본에 분포한다.

sexes.text: 암수 색이 비슷하며, 수컷이 암컷보다 조금 크다.

art.subject: Common Cuckoo (Cuculus canorus), adult male, grey type (most adult females look the same), as seen in Korea from May to August: head, upperparts, throat and upper breast plain ash-grey, darker slate on the wings; lower breast, belly and flanks white with thin, evenly spaced dark grey bars; undertail coverts white with sparse bars; tail long and graduated, blackish-grey with small white spots along the shafts and white tips. Bill dark grey with a yellow base and gape. Iris and bare eye-ring yellow. Short yellow legs.
art.pose: perched on an exposed branch at a field edge
art.scene: Korean lowland hills bordering open fields and farmland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched horizontally on a branch: yellow iris and eye-ring, ash-grey head, upperparts and upper breast, drooped slate wings, long blackish tail with white spots, white belly with thin dark bars, small yellow feet
adult, front view perched: ash-grey throat and upper breast cut off sharply from the white, thinly barred belly; yellow eye-ring
art.build: Slim, long-tailed, long-winged bird, 32–36cm, about the length of a feral pigeon but much slimmer, with a small head; recalls a small falcon or sparrowhawk in shape. Bill short (shorter than the head), slightly decurved, not hooked. Legs very short, yellow, two toes forward and two back. Perches horizontally with the wings drooped at the sides below the tail base and the long graduated tail often slightly raised or fanned. In flight pointed wings beating mostly below body level, long tail, head held up.
avoid: Do not paint a hooked raptor bill or strong talons; despite its hawk-like shape it has a small, slightly curved bill and tiny yellow feet.
Do not paint broad, widely spaced black bars; Common Cuckoo's bars are thin (broader bars suggest Oriental Cuckoo).
Do not paint a dark or red iris; it is yellow.
Do not extend the grey onto the belly; the grey ends on the upper breast.
